‘Don’t Cancel Me, Please’: Degenerate Shock Jock Howard Stern Says Joe Rogan’s Apology Should Have Been “I’m Wrong, Go Get a Vaccine Before You Die”

Howard Stern in blackface
Former shock jock and current radio mouthpiece for the establishment Howard Stern o
ffered his two cents
on Joe Rogan’s recent apologies over the whole Spotify controversy, telling the extremely popular podcaster that his apology should have included an admission of guilt and instructions for his listeners that they will die if they don’t get the vaccine.
In
response
to Rogan’s apology video, Stern crooned that he should have said “I’m wrong, and go get the vaccine before you die,” during his radio show on Tuesday.
Stern
continued to address
the controversy to his listeners, calling the entire situation “silly,” and blasting Rogan for not knowing what he’s talking about because he doesn’t have a medical background – as if Stern did not just tell Rogan to weaponize propagandistic fear porn against his listeners by telling them that Covid – a flu-like or cold-like virus for the vast majority of people with a 99.95-99.99% recovery rate – will kill them without the vaccine.
But Stern has sCiENcE on his side, so he knows what he’s talking about.
“The whole thing with Joe Rogan is so silly to me. Even the apology he just should’ve said, ‘You know what? Listen, I’m a comedian… And I have no idea what I’m talking about.’
“I have no I have no medical background whatsoever to be telling people what to do with their health.”
Stern’s outrageous comments come just weeks after he had advocated for hospitals to refuse treatment to unvaccinated individuals in favor of sending them home to die.
Because just like his vaccine comments, sCiEnCe says it’s for your health, and he knows what he’s talking about.
After all, he says he has taken the vaccine “three times” and the worst of it was that “he had a little bit of a headache,” so take your booster, you sheep. If not, you deserve to die, according to Stern.
Howard Stern Rips Unvaccinated Americans: ‘In My America,’ All Hospitals Would Be Closed To You — ‘Go Home And Die’
Also, back in September, Stern
viciously smeared
people who refuse to get the Covid vaccine as “imbeciles” who should “go f*ck yourself.”
“When are we gonna stop putting up with the idiots in this country and just say it’s mandatory to get vaccinated? F*ck ’em. Fuck their freedom. I want my freedom to live,” he said. “I want to get out of the house already. I want to go next door and play chess. I want to go take some pictures.”
Stern has changed quite dramatically from the Stern of old. In order to cover his cancelable tracks, and stay off of the woke mob's naughty list, Stern must bootlick for the establishment every chance he gets. Gone are the days of the shock jock who lit talk radio on fire, rising to prominence through politically incorrect and wild discussion.
Now, he is just another tool for the elite to push their propaganda.
How else do you explain videos like the one below floating around, without drawing the ire of the intolerant left?
And that's just the tip of the iceberg. Half of his total air time over the years, if not more, is chalked full of cancelable moments, where, if someone on the conservative side of the aisle were to have been caught doing, would be banished to the outer darkness where there is wailing and gnashing of teeth, as Michael J. Knowles would put it.
What a clown.
